notes.title: 2021/10/09 Bug fix.
notes.notes:
Fixed instant death immediately after the start of some stages by adding an invincibility period at the start.
Objects that were easy to slip through in some levels are now harder to slip through.
Removed debug text from some menu screens.

notes.title: 2021/10/08 Bug fix.
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem where certain sound effects did not reflect the volume setting.
Fixed a bug that made it difficult to understand what to do in certain levels.
